commits.message:
feat(style): Isolate archive styles and resolve 404 error

Theme's head.ejs conditionally loads 'css/archive.css' for archive, category, and tag pages. Since this file was missing, it caused a 404 console error on these pages.

This commit resolves the issue by creating `archive.scss`. It also improves style organization by moving the dedicated `.post-list.archives` block from `post-list.scss` into the new `archive.scss`.

The change ensures:
1. The 404 error is eliminated.
2. Archive-specific styles are loaded only when needed.
3. Style codebase is better maintained.
Remove duplicating CSS and Disable archive.scss for the pages don’t need
